hook: A million euro fraud scheme targeted NATO naval operations until international police raided multiple countries.

sections.voiceover: A million euro fraud scheme targeted NATO naval operations until international police raided multiple countries.
b_roll: Digital map of Europe highlighting international jurisdictions

sections.voiceover: On an international sweep, Økokrim arrested five people in Norway for supplying fraudulent equipment to warships. Eurojust coordinated simultaneous searches across Germany and Romania. How did a supplier exploit NATO naval contracts?
b_roll: Map showing Norway, Germany, and Romania

sections.voiceover: Eurojust uncovered bribery networks inside defense supply chains.
Officers searched properties in Germany and Romania. The EUR 1 million fraud collapsed completely.
b_roll: Law enforcement officers entering a facility

sections.voiceover: Five suspects face prosecution in Bergen.
